facts.fact: Egypt's National Council for AI, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies adopted the achievements report on the Second Edition of the National AI Strategy (2025-2030) covering the first half of 2026; the meeting date is not stated, so the document's published date is used.

The National Council for AI, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies, chaired by the ICT minister, met to follow up the National AI Strategy and reviewed its progress across six pillars; the meeting date is not stated, so the document's published date is used.
